topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The old wooden door creaks as I push it open, the familiar scent of lavender and dust mingling in the air. My hands are a bit clammy as I step inside, memories flooding back with each creak of the floorboards. This house, our grandmother’s sanctuary, now belongs to my sister and me. It’s a lot to take in, the weight of it all. I try to focus on the positive, the chance to keep her legacy alive, but the thought of what to do next feels heavy. Walking through the rooms, each one a reminder of her, I can’t help but feel a sense of duty mixed with something else, a flutter of uncertainty. What if we can’t live up to the stories this house holds?
